youtube_description:
Dubai is hosting the world's biggest AI competition, where people compete to find the most effective ways to communicate with AI.

Art, Literature, and Coding are the challenge categories for the prize of $270,000. 

When I first saw the competition, I thought, of course, the competition makes so much sense to host. 

Prompt engineers are a growing global talent pool and Dubai is such a right fit for them.

Don't be surprised when your kids choose a career in prompt engineering
